lines.text: Mahinda Bandara's campaign tent is on the edge of town near the main road. Flags everywhere. A jingle playing at volumes that raise questions about neighbourhood consent.

lines.speaker: Mahinda Bandara
lines.text: Welcome! Welcome, come in! Have you had a cold drink? Sit — I was just speaking to some young people about the future of this area.

lines.speaker: Mahinda Bandara
lines.text: We have a very strong plan. Infrastructure. Jobs. The road — we have been working on the road. It is a priority. Top of the list.

lines.speaker: Mahinda Bandara
lines.text: Ah, you read the manifesto! Very good. Informed voters — that is what we need. The road section — the timelines are there. Everything is in the document.

lines.speaker: Mahinda Bandara
lines.text: The posters — I have spoken to the team about that. A misunderstanding. We follow all proper procedures.

lines.prompt: What do you want to do here?

choices.label: Read the manifesto on the table.
Look at that unmarked box in the corner.
